achievements.name: First Star
achievements.detail: Reach the Power Star at the end of a course.

achievements.name: Gem Trio
achievements.detail: Collect all three gems hidden in a single course.

achievements.name: Bonus Goal
achievements.detail: Complete a course's optional bonus objective.

achievements.name: Pixel Toad
achievements.detail: Find the tiny hidden Toad tucked into a course.

achievements.name: Toadette's Turn
achievements.detail: Clear a course while playing as Toadette.

achievements.name: Mine Cart
achievements.detail: Ride a mine cart through a course and collect the star.

achievements.name: Episode 1
achievements.detail: Clear every course in the first episode.

achievements.name: Episode 2
achievements.detail: Clear every course in the second episode.

achievements.name: Episode 3
achievements.detail: Clear every course in the third episode.

achievements.name: Special Episode
achievements.detail: Clear a course from the Special Episode.

achievements.name: Main Book
achievements.detail: Clear every course in the three main episodes.

achievements.name: Full Clear
achievements.detail: On every main-episode course, also collect the gems, the bonus objective, and the hidden Toad.
